about:
Stalin's Triumph Battlepack 1



Stalin's Triumph Battlepack 1 brings us to the endless plains of the Soviet Union in July 1943.  Stalin's Triumph Battlepack 1 includes 13 scenarios in a clash of the giants, the Soviet Red Army defends the Motherland against its German invaders.  Command some of the most fearsome formations as the 11th Panzer Division and the Desert Rats. Centered on the area of Kursk in 1943 and places you in the fighting in and around the northern and southern flanks of the battle.



Stalin’s Triumph Battlepack 1 depicts platoon-level combat on the Eastern Front during World War 2.   All of the vehicles, men, and weapons of the Soviet and German armies that fought in and around the area of Kursk in the summer of 1943. The game includes Soviet units such as the famed animal killer, the SU-152, and the workhorse of the Soviet Army, the T-34. For Germany, there’s a wide array of hardware such as Tigers and Mk IVs, but also unique vehicles such as the Flamepanzer and the dreaded Elephant. Included in the game are new rules for tank riders, commissars, fighter planes, goliaths, and rockets. Battles depict actions around such famed areas as Prochorovka and Ponyri.
